meta.title: Contact: free intro call
meta.description: Request a free, no-obligation intro call (about 30 minutes) on audits, training and consulting to ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 19011 and GMP. Reply within one working day.

head.title: Book your free intro call
head.lead: About 30 minutes, free and without obligation. Send your enquiry and I will get back to you personally within one working day with a proposed date.

form.title: Your enquiry
form.name: Name

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: e.g. supplier audit to ISO 13485, one site, Stuttgart area

form.consent: I have read the <link>privacy policy</link> and agree to my details being processed to handle this enquiry.

errors.email: Please enter a valid email address, e.g. name@company.com.
errors.invalid: Please choose one of the options offered.
errors.consent: Please agree to the processing of your details so that I can handle your enquiry.

sendError.title: Unfortunately, your enquiry could not be sent.
sendError.text: Please try again later or get in touch directly: by phone on <phoneLink>{phone}</phoneLink> or by email to <emailLink>{email}</emailLink>.

success.title: Thank you, your enquiry has been received.
success.text: You will receive a confirmation by email and, within one working day, a proposed date for the intro call.

aside.promise: Every enquiry is answered personally within one working day.

direct.title: Direct contact
direct.locationText: {city}, Germany. Audits throughout Germany and Europe.

steps.confirmation: You receive a confirmation by email.
steps.reply: I get back to you personally within one working day with a proposed date.
steps.call: Free intro call, about 30 minutes, no obligation.
steps.proposal: Afterwards you receive a fixed proposal.

notification.subject: New enquiry: {topic} · {company}
notification.heading: New enquiry via the contact form
notification.intro: {name} ({company}) has requested a free intro call via the website. Use “Reply” to write directly to {email}.
notification.footer: Sent via the contact form on {site}. Consent to processing the details was given.

confirmation.subject: Your enquiry to {brand} has been received
confirmation.thanks: Thank you for your enquiry, it has reached me safely.
confirmation.next: I will get back to you personally within one working day and propose a date for the free intro call. The call takes about 30 minutes and is without obligation.
confirmation.questions: If you have any questions in the meantime, simply reply to this email or call me on {phone}.
confirmation.footer: You are receiving this email because an enquiry with your email address was sent via the contact form on {site}. If this was not you, you can ignore this message.
